```sql
with fx as (
    select c.rate_date,
           c.currency,
           cast(c.usd_per_unit / r.usd_per_unit as decimal(38,12)) as to_reporting
    from fx_rates c
    join fx_rates r
      on r.rate_date = c.rate_date
     and r.currency = 'USD'
),
captures as (
    select co.name as country_name,
           case
             when a.business_date between date '2026-07-13' and date '2026-09-06' then 'last_8_weeks'
             when a.business_date between date '2026-05-18' and date '2026-07-12' then 'previous_8_weeks'
           end as period_label,
           a.amount_minor,
           a.currency,
           a.business_date,
           row_number() over (
               partition by a.order_id, a.amount_minor
               order by a.attempt_no, a.attempt_id
           ) as capture_rank
    from payment_attempts a
    join orders o on o.order_id = a.order_id
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    join countries co on co.country_code = s.country_code
    where a.status = 'captured'
      and not a.is_test
      and not o.is_test
      and a.business_date between date '2026-05-18' and date '2026-09-06'
)
select country_name || ' | ' || period_label as key,
       cast(round(sum(amount_minor * fx.to_reporting)) as bigint) as value
from captures c
join fx
  on fx.currency = c.currency
 and fx.rate_date = c.business_date
where capture_rank = 1
group by country_name, period_label
order by country_name asc, period_label asc
```
